sections.title: How we confirm your address
body: The radius is a straight-line estimate, not a road distance, and a town being listed doesn’t guarantee every address in its territory. That’s why each location and appointment is confirmed with you individually.

sections.title: Near the boundary
body: Val-des-Bois sits near the limit of our area, so it depends on your exact address. Our service stays in Quebec, so addresses in Ottawa and elsewhere in Ontario aren’t covered.
